answer_1.quote: There has been a recent surge of interest in summarizers based on large pre-trained language models (PLMs), where various summarization tasks... have been proposed to meet different practical demands.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE for automatic evaluation... which evaluates the n-gram overlap in the model-generated summary against the reference summary.

answer_4.quote: To better understand the outputs of different few-shot summarization systems, following, we conduct a human evaluation from four dimensions: Fluency, Consistency, Coherence and Relevance.
answer_4.guideline: We ask a judge... to give scores from 1 to 5 along each evaluation dimension.
